apps.name: BREAKOUT
apps.description: Breakout: five rows of bricks on top, a 3-wide paddle near the bottom, and the octagon's angled walls to bounce off. C / D move the paddle (hold to keep moving); where the ball hits the paddle steers it. Clear all the bricks for a new wave, a little faster. 3 lives, shown blue on the top arms; the score fills the arms orange. After the last life, any button starts again. As in the previous firmware's breakout.

apps.name: FLAPPY
apps.description: Flappy: one button. B, C or D flaps; fly through the gaps in the pipes. The bird waits until the first flap. Hitting a pipe or the edge of the grid ends the game; the arms fill gold with the pipes you passed, and after the end the grid shows the score, the outline the best. As in the previous firmware's flappy.

apps.name: PONG
apps.description: Pong against the badge: your paddle on the left edge, the badge's on the right. B moves yours up, D down (hold to keep moving); where the ball hits a paddle steers it. First to 5 wins. The left arms show your points in blue, the right arms the badge's in red. After a game the grid shows the score, the outline your wins so far (kept on the badge); any button starts the next game. As in the previous firmware's pong.

apps.name: SIMON
apps.description: Simon says: the badge plays a sequence on the four arms next to the buttons, and you press it back. Every round adds one. The top arm shows how far you are, and lights green when you got it all. A wrong button, or 5 s without one, ends the game; any button then starts again. The grid shows the length; the outline the length and (dimly) the best so far. As in the previous firmware's Simon.

apps.name: SNAKE
apps.description: Snake on the centre grid. C turns left, D turns right; eat the blinking dot. The outline counts the score, dimly up to the best score so far (kept on the badge). After a crash the score shows as a number; A or B starts again.

apps.name: SPARKLE
apps.description: Sparkles on the grid and the outline, a rainbow turning round the arms. B: more sparkles, D: fewer.

apps.name: STARTRIS
apps.description: Startris: a 9-wide, 14-deep well in the middle of the octagon. C / D move the piece (hold to repeat), tap A to rotate, B drops it. Full rows clear; the more lines, the faster the pieces fall. The arms show the next piece's colour and fill with the lines you cleared. When a new piece has no room, the game is over: the grid shows the lines, the outline the best (kept on the badge), and any button starts again. As in the previous firmware's Startris.

apps.name: WHACK
apps.description: Whack-a-mole: a random arm lights up from its tip towards the centre, one LED at a time. Stop it with any button before it reaches the centre: the sooner, the more points (5 with one LED lit, 2 with four). Reaching the centre ends the game, and so does pressing while nothing is lit. It gets faster every 3 hits. The grid shows the points, the outline the best so far; after the end, any button starts again. As in the previous firmware's whack-a-mole.
